veranderings.rede: 'Skree oor mekaar' copies English 'shout over each other' and reads in Afrikaans as 'shout about each other'; 'skree op mekaar' is the natural form.

veranderings.blok: By die huis, by die skool en in die gemeenskap
veranderings.voor: Geweld hoort nie by sekere mense of by sekere plekke nie
veranderings.na: Geweld gebeur nie net by sekere mense of op sekere plekke nie
veranderings.rede: 'Hoort nie by' is vague and can read as 'violence does not suit certain people'; the block means violence is not confined to some people or places, and the preposition with 'plekke' is 'op'.

veranderings.blok: Wat jy doen as dit begin
veranderings.na: na 'n ander kamer of na 'n buurman
veranderings.rede: Repeating 'na' keeps the two destinations parallel and stops 'kamer of buurman' reading as one phrase; the protected wording after it is unchanged.

veranderings.blok: Wat jy doen as dit begin
veranderings.voor: soos 'n klaskamer met 'n onderwyser of 'n winkel
veranderings.na: soos 'n klaskamer waar 'n onderwyser is, of 'n winkel
veranderings.rede: As written it can read as 'a classroom with a teacher or with a shop'; this makes clear the shop is a second place.
Repeating 'met' after the long relative clause makes clear the neighbour is a second person to talk to; the protected wordings on both sides are unchanged.

vlae.teks: Wanneer iemand 'n ander mens aspris seermaak of op die punt staan om dit te doen.
vlae.rede: A noun is defined with a 'wanneer' clause; '’n Situasie waarin iemand ...' would be the proper form. Not proposed as a change because the same words, differing only in case, also stand in the first study block, so the 'voor' would not be unique.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: om te wen of terug te kry nie
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: 'Iemand terugkry' for revenge is colloquial and close to English 'get someone back'; 'terugkry' normally means 'get something back'. 'Om te wen of wraak te neem' would be clearer, but the wording is protected, so left for a person to decide.
